BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Amalgam!!
Well well well, you've given me a really hard\ntime. Have you prepared yourselves?
W-wait! We don't wanna fight you anymore!
We'll be good and we'll leave your world! So...!
So that's why I'm telling you that I'm sending you\nto another world immediately!\nC'mon get your ass here quickly!
I don't think she'll be sending them to the world\nthey meant...
It's never crossed my mind that she would\nsympathize with those monsters...
That's not your problem tho, it's her problem...
Goodbye and I'll forget you guys!\nI never remember you guys anyway.
I-i-if it continues like this...!
Isn't there any way to stop it...?!
C-Caylass! What's going on?
I-I have no idea either.\nI'm lost...
W-what's that?!
W-w-wait what?!\nThis ain't no joke!
So we merged into one...?! Moreover, I've never\nfelt this powerful before...! Bwahaha...\nThis time it's your turn to prepare yourselves!
Dammit, he's challenging us!\nYou should get pumped up too!
What's going on here?! My attack doesn't work...?
What? You mean we can punch him as many times as\nwe want?
I have no idea how your brain works.
Seems like the miasma around his body is\ncountering the attack...!
This is awesome...!\nI didn't expect this kind of power to be awakened\nat the last minute...
You should thank me!
Uh-oh...
Don't make him do unnecessary things because none\nof us can beat him now...\nLet's just retreat for now!
You didn't learn your lesson, huh!\nYou think your attack will work on my current\nform...?
What's with that sword?!
This is my scarlet sakura...fairy sword.\nI've specially unsealed it just to let you taste\nit...So come and taste it as much as you want♪!
Fairy sword?! Seal?!\nWhat is wrong with this girl?!\nWhat kind of world is this?!
You talk too much, just shut the fudge up...\nJust die alreadyyy!!
W-what...!\nB-but, it's not that I've lost to you!
Alright, that's it, bring it on!\nI won't go easy on you...Hmm?
Just let us take care of him from now on!
B-but, w-wait!\nLet me fight him too!\nLemme slash him, pleeease!
Oh, Tenert, adventurer!\nWe'll leave him to you then!
Well, shall we put them nicely and have a toast?\nHey, how should we arrange them?
Err, that's kinda troublesome and I don't think\nwe want a hanami that smells bloody...
Since the flowers have fully bloomed too,\nwe may as well want to enjoy them peacefully...
Oh...okay then if that's what you want...
Hey, if you promise to be good and stop doing bad\nthings in my world, I can let you go.
D-don't worry, even if you ask, we'll never want\nto come back to a place like this...
To Tenert and adventurer, I'm sorry too. You came\nall the way here but ended up doing strenuous\nwork...It's not much, but please take this.
Sigh, it always ends up like this whenever I'm\nwith you. This is the most exhausting hanami that\nI've ever experienced.
It certainly is. But, if that's the cost for\nsaving the night sakura world, it's cheap. Aight,\nI'll go back too. I need to tell Libera and Virgo.
And we can have a feast again.\nPlease come with Libera and Virgo next time!
W-who is it?! Oh, it's you lot...
Wow, they're really becoming one again.
It's not like we want it! It's that scary girl's\nfault for wielding the fairy sword, causing us\nto be shrouded in some strange mist.
And we're already like this when we looked at\nourselves again...We wanna get out of this world\nquickly too, but in our original form...
Isn't it good to be in that form?\nI thought you're stronger like that, no?
It reminds us of that scary girl if we stay in\nthis form. Honestly, we also want to forget\neverything that happened here...
Hmm, maybe if we fight you again, you'll go back\nto your original form, but oh, this is driving me\nnuts...Okay, fine then.
Hey, fight this thing again! Make it quick!
